4 case reopened

On 10-10-40 C.B.H.Q. C.I. detectives whilst
rendering assistance to the Japanese Gendarmerie
carried out a raid at No.4 Lane 429 Amiral Bayle P.O.
wherein it was reported members of an anti-Japanese
Terrorist Organization known as "Blue Shirts" were
residing.

No arrests were made but a number of arms
and a quantity of ammunition were seized.

Amongst these firearms one, a Smith & Wesson
.38 revolver No.51387 was upon examination found to
have been used in the attempt on the life of Dr.Jordan
the subject of this file.

Arrests which were made during the round up
could not be connected with this offence.

Please see C.I.Misc.197/40.

D. S.

案件重开

1940年10月10日，刑事侦缉处总部的华籍侦探在协助日本宪兵队时，对白利南路429弄4号进行了一次突击搜查，据报有名为“蓝衣社”的反日恐怖组织成员居住于此。

虽未实施逮捕，但缴获了若干武器及一批弹药。

在这些枪支中，经检验发现一支史密斯威森（Smith & Wesson）.38口径左轮手枪，编号51387，曾被用于企图谋杀乔丹博士（Dr. Jordan）的案件，即本案卷宗所涉事项。

在此次 roundup（搜捕行动）中实施的逮捕与本案罪行无法建立联系。

请参阅中央分局杂项档案 197/40。

D. S.

documents, etc., which were found in the office

with the documents in question were handed to
D.S. Henchman, Central, at 3 p.m., Spetember 20,
1940.

两名中国男性，其中一人携带武器，通过走廊门口进入办公室。未携带武器者守在门口，而携带武器者进入房间并询问施某。当询问此人来意时，后者掏出一把手枪（或左轮手枪）并开了三枪，其中一枪击中。随后两人逃窜，据信是通过楼梯和正门离开大楼。

pages.en:
enquiries by undersigned and C.D.S.335.
Following the receipt of a telephone message
which stated that a Shanghai Fire Brigade Ambulance
had been called to No.24 Central Road, the undersigned
accompanied by C.D.S.335 went to this address outside
of which a large crowd had collected.
Detectives were directed to Room 305 on the 3rd
floor of 24 Central Road where several Chinese and
foreigners were gathered. The undersigned was inform-
ed that a few moments before noon a Chinese male had
entered the room and drawing a pistol had fired three
shots one of which had wounded Mr. Jordan Darco Sze
alias Sze Jeu Dong(史久常); a Chinese lawyer. An
ambulance had already been called and the wounded man
had been conveyed to hospital where a Doctor's chit
was issued which read as follows:-
"Gun-shot wound face and fracture of base of
skull - very serious".
The room in which the shooting took place is used as
an office by the following concerns and persons:-
1. Jordan Sze, Barrister-at-law, (injured man)
2. Deku Shing, Korean, Dry-goods broker.
3. Tung Yich Ho, Transportation Service.
4. W. Markelos, Far East Magazine.
It having been ascertained that the would-be assassin
had already absconded a thorough examination of the
room was conducted. Entrance to the room is obtained
by a door which opens on to the corridor; once inside
the door one passes along a short passage-way beside
a bath-room and then enters the main office. Several
pages.zh:
由下述签署人及刑事侦缉处警士335号进行调查。
接到一通电话消息，称上海救火会救护车已被召往中央路24号后，下述签署人随同刑事侦缉处警士335号前往该地址，当时门外已聚集了大量人群。
侦探被指引至中央路24号三楼的305室，那里聚集了几名中国人和外国人。下述签署人获悉，就在中午前片刻，一名中国男性进入房间，拔出手枪开了三枪，其中一枪击伤了乔丹·达尔科·施（Jordan Darco Sze），又名史久常（Sze Jeu Dong）；一名中国律师。救护车此前已被呼叫，伤者已被送往医院，医生出具的诊断单内容如下：-
“面部枪伤及颅底骨折 - 伤势极重”。
发生枪击的房间由以下机构和个人用作办公室：-
1. 乔丹·施（Jordan Sze），出庭律师，（伤者）
2. 德库·辛（Deku Shing），朝鲜人，百货经纪人。
3. 董义和（Tung Yich Ho，音译），运输服务。
4. W. Markelos，《远东杂志》。
在确定企图行凶者已经潜逃后，对房间进行了彻底检查。进入房间需经过一扇通向走廊的门；进门后，经过浴室旁的一条短通道，然后进入主办公室。几张

pages.en:
1/3

desks occupy the floor and are separated from the passage
by a wooden counter. The wounded man's desk is in the
Centre of the room and is placed so that when he sits
down his profile and back are visible to any one entering.
On the floor surrounding Sze's desk was a large pool of
blood. An exhaustive search failed to reveal any
cartridge cases but a soft-nosed much flattened bullet,
probably of .38 revolver calibre, was discovered on the
floor in the corner opposite to the door way. Papers and
documents found in Sze's desk were brought to the Station
for examination.

On the arrival of the Police the following persons
who had witnessed the shooting were present:
1. Paul Seawirth, Czech, sailor.
2. Motih Zweis, Refugee, salesman.
3. Johann Goldstein, Refugee, salesman .
4. Wong Wei(王偉) Clerk, Kung Sung Weekly Review.
5. Dong Tsing Foo(唐晋富) Apprentice, employed in
Room 306.
6. Leh Sih Fung(陸錫勳) Clerk, Tung Yieh Co.
7. Liu Tsing Yuen(劉清源) Fruit-merchant, F.C.

The above persons were taken to the Station where state-
ments from all were obtained. It was ascertained that
besides the above-named, one Beim Shing, a Korean sharing
the same office and an old friend of Sze had witnessed the
pages.zh:
1/3

办公桌占据着地面，并通过一个木制柜台与通道隔开。伤者的办公桌位于房间中央，摆放位置使得当他坐下时，任何进入的人都能看到他的侧面和背部。施某办公桌周围的地板上有一大滩血。经过详尽搜索，未发现任何弹壳，但在门口对面的角落地板上发现了一颗软头且严重变形的子弹，可能是.38口径左轮手枪子弹。在施某办公桌上发现的文件和单据被带至巡捕房进行检查。

警察到达时，以下目击枪击事件的人员在场：
1. 保罗·西尔维斯（Paul Seawirth），捷克人，海员。
2. 莫蒂赫·兹韦斯（Motih Zweis），难民，推销员。
3. 约翰·戈尔德斯坦（Johann Goldstein），难民，推销员。
4. 王伟（Wong Wei），《公颂周刊》（Kung Sung Weekly Review，音译）职员。
5. 唐晋富（Dong Tsing Foo），学徒，受雇于306室。
6. 陆锡勋（Leh Sih Fung），通益公司（Tung Yieh Co.，音译）职员。
7. 刘清源（Liu Tsing Yuen），水果商，法租界。

上述人员被带至巡捕房，并获取了所有人的供词。经查实，除上述人员外，共用同一办公室且为施某老朋友的朝鲜人贝姆·辛（Beim Shing，音译）也目击了

pages.en:
1/4

shooting and had then accompanied the wounded man to the
Lester Hospital. He was subsequently requested to attend
the Station where he made a full statement. A statement
was also made by C.P.C.863 who was on duty at the corner
of Szechuen Road and Kiukiang Road and heard the shooting.
S.P.W. 164 on duty at the entrance to No.24 states that
he heard the shooting upstairs but maintains that he saw
no suspicious characters leaving the building.

The undersigned visited the Lester Hospital and
endeavoured to question Sze; the latter, however, due to
excessive weakness was unable to say more than that he
had not recognised the man responsible for the shooting,
that he had no enemies and no political affiliations ---
he spoke fluent English.

Perusal of the various statements made by witnesses
makes it possible to recount the story of the actual
shooting as follows:

It appears that Sze came to his office at Central
Road at about 9a.m. During the course of the morning he
interviewed several persons amongst whom were two Japanese
who are believed to have been present at the time of the
shooting but as yet, have not been located. Shortly before
noon (the time varies in the statements of the several
witnesses) two male Chinese (described on Sheet No.1)
entered through the doorway; the one who was wearing
pages.zh:
1/4

枪击事件，并随后陪同伤者前往莱斯特医院。随后他被要求到巡捕房作了完整供词。当时在四川路与九江路口执勤的巡捕863号也作了供词，他听到了枪声。在24号入口处执勤的特别巡捕164号称，他听到楼上的枪声，但坚持表示没有看到可疑人物离开大楼。

下述签署人走访了莱斯特医院并试图讯问施某；然而，后者因极度虚弱，除了表示不认识负责枪击的人、没有敌人且无政治派系 affiliation 之外，说不出更多内容 --- 他能说流利的英语。

通过审阅证人作出的各项供词，可以复述实际枪击经过如下：

看来施某大约在上午9点来到他在中央路的办公室。上午期间，他会见了几个人，其中包括两名日本人，据信他们在枪击发生时在场，但尚未找到。临近中午时（几位证人的供词中时间略有不同），两名中国男性（详见第1页描述）通过门口进入；其中一名身穿

pages.en:
1/5

Chinese clothing remained by the door while the other who
was dressed in foreign clothing, walked up to the counter
and asked for Sze. Sze who was sitting at his desk, turned
and asked the man what he wanted whereupon the latter
put his hand into the right side-pocket of his jacket,
drew out a small black pistol (or revolver) and fired
three shots, one of which struck Sze in the face. The
two men then absconded leaving the building, it is believed
by way of the stairs and the main entrance. (There is a
back entrance to the building but the door leading to it
is locked)

Special mention should be given to the willing and
useful assistance rendered by Special Constable Isaacs
who was passing near-by at the time of the shooting and
was on the scene before the arrival of the regular Police.

No motive for the crime has as yet been discovered;
Sze is known to have had connections with a certain
Seamen's Union and to number several Japanese amongst his
acquaintances.

Investigation with a view to the eventual apprehension
of the criminals is proceeding.

The D.C. Crime, the D.O. and the D.D.O. were informed;
copies of reports and statements will be forwarded to the
Special Branch, D.C. Divisions and Supt. I/C C.I.

1/5

中式服装的人留在门口，而另一名身穿西式服装的人走到柜台前询问施某。坐在办公桌前的施某转过身，问此人有何事，随即后者将手伸进夹克右侧口袋，掏出一把黑色小手枪（或左轮手枪）并开了三枪，其中一枪击中施某面部。随后两人逃窜，据信是通过楼梯和正门离开大楼。（大楼有一个后门，但通往后门的门是锁着的）

应特别提及特别警员艾萨克斯（Isaacs）提供的自愿且有用的协助，他在枪击发生时正路过附近，并在正规警察到达之前赶到了现场。

目前尚未发现犯罪动机；已知施某与某个海员工会有联系，且其熟人中有几名日本人。

旨在最终抓获罪犯的调查正在进行中。

刑事侦缉处副处长、分区警官及副分区警官已获知此事；报告和供词的副本将发送至特务科、刑事侦缉处各分区及华籍侦探主管督察。

pages.en:
Paul Neawirth
Czechoslovakia D.S. Cooke
Central Stn. 19/8/40.

My name is Paul Neawirth, 23, native of Cecho-Slovakia, a sailor,
residing 783, Point road, house 46.
At about 9a.m., 19/8/40 I was waiting in Room No.305 of
House No.24 Central Road, the old British Military Hospital, to
see a Mr. Shark, a Korean lawyer, who has his office at that
address, and with whom I had some business, he arrived at about
10a.m., but he did not attend to me right away. He was busy with
some Japanese clients, whom I have never seen before, he was
also busy with Mr. Sze, a Chinese Lawyer who shares the office
with Mr Shark.
At about 12.05p.m., 19/8/40, as I was still waiting for
an interview I saw a male Chinese, age about 26, height about
5ft. 9 inches, thin build, thin dark face, dressed in a foreign
style dark blue suit, with narrow white striped, black shoes,
I have never seen the man before, but I would recognise him again
if I saw him, this man came into the office through the open door,
he said nothing, but bowed to Mr Sze, Mr Sze asked him what he
wanted, in Chinese, but the man made no reply, while this was
going on another male Chinese, age about 35, height about 5'2",
strongly built, round face, with a scar stretching from his
forehead to his temple on the left side of his face, he was
dressed in a dark grey long gown, black Chinese shoes, he was
bald, I have never seen him before but I would recognise him
again, this man remained standing in the doorway, he seemed to
be watching for something. Suddenly the man in the room put
his hand into the right pocket of his trouser pocket and took
out a small black automatic pistol, pointed the pistol at Mr Sze,
pages.zh:
保罗·尼沃思 (Paul Neawirth)
捷克斯洛伐克 D.S. 库克 (D.S. Cooke)
中央捕房 1940年8月19日。

我叫保罗·尼沃思，23岁，捷克斯洛伐克人，海员，
住百老汇路783号46室。
1940年8月19日上午9点左右，我在中央路24号
（原英军医院）305室等候，
去见一位沙克 (Shark) 先生，他是一位朝鲜律师，
办公室就在此处，我与他有些事务需要处理。他大约在
上午10点到达，但没有立即接待我。他正忙于接待
几位日本客户，我以前从未见过这些人；他还忙着接待
与沙克先生共用办公室的中国律师施 (Sze) 先生。
1940年8月19日中午12点05分左右，当我仍在等待
面谈时，我看到一名中国男子，年龄约26岁，身高约
5英尺9英寸，身材瘦削，面色黝黑消瘦，身穿西式
深蓝色西装，配有细白条纹，脚穿黑皮鞋。我以前
从未见过此人，但如果再见到我能够认出。此人通过
敞开的门进入办公室，一言不发，只是向施先生鞠躬。
施先生用中文问他有什么事，但此人没有回答。就在
这时，另一名中国男子，年龄约35岁，身高约5英尺
2英寸，体格强壮，圆脸，左脸有一道从额头延伸至
太阳穴的伤疤。他身穿深灰色长衫，黑布鞋，光头。
我以前从未见过他，但如果再见到我能够认出。此人
站在门口，似乎在观察着什么。突然，屋内的男子将
手伸进裤子右边的口袋，掏出一把黑色小型自动手枪，
将枪口对准施先生，

pages.en:
Page 2

who was sitting at his desk, and as Mr Sze turned round a little
in his chair, this man, holding the pistol, in his right hand,
the barrel between his first and second fingers pulled the trigger
with his third finger and fired three shots at Mr Sze, the first
shot struck the pipe which Mr Sze was smoking, the second shot
struck the right side of his face, the third shot went wild,
the man who done the shooting said something in Chinese and
immediately turned round and ran out and was joined by the man
who had remained standing in the doorway.

At the time of the shooting besides myself and Mr Sze, there
were in the office, two Foreigners, three Chinese and two
Japanese and Mr Shark, after the shooting , one Japanese and one
Chinese was missing, I did not notice them go.

I do not know anything more.

Signed.
pages.zh:
第2页

施先生当时正坐在办公桌前。当施先生在椅子上稍微
转身时，这名男子右手持枪，枪管夹在食指和中指之间，
用中指扣动扳机，向施先生开了三枪。第一枪击中了
施先生正在抽的烟斗，第二枪击中了他右脸，第三枪
打偏了。开枪的男子用中文说了些什么，随即转身跑
了出去，与一直站在门口的那名男子会合。

枪击发生时，除了我和施先生外，办公室里还有两名
外国人、三名中国人和两名日本人以及沙克先生。枪击
发生后，一名日本人和一名中国人不见了，我没有注意
到他们离开。

我对此一无所知。

签名。

pages.en:
Motih Zweig,
Austrian, 2 Quinsan-Garden Room 8.
Central Stn. 19-9-40.

On Sept. 19th, at about 11,15a.m. I entered the office of
the Welfare Co. Room 315 24 Central Road together with my
partner Mr. Johann Goldstein to offer handbags. Whilst
displaying our goods, Mr. Jordan Sze showed interest and ordered
two handbags for his wife and his sister. Thereupon he went
back to his writing-desk and sat down. We continued talking
to the manager of above firm. At about 11.45a.m. I noticed a
male Chinese, dressed in foreign-style clothes, entering the
office and walking up to the counter. He stood about 2 feet
away from me on my left. I heard him muttering a few words
which I did not understand and noticed him looking about the
room. When he saw Mr. Sze, he removed his right hand from his
pocket and fired three shots at Mr. Sze. This done the
assailant immediately turned around and left the office. I ran
out into the corridor, shouting "Police", but noticed nobody in
the vicinity. Thereupon I returned into the office shouting
"Police" from one of the windows down on the road.

Sgd: Motih Zweig.
pages.zh:
莫蒂希·茨威格 (Motih Zweig)，
奥地利人，昆山路花园2号8室。
中央捕房 1940年9月19日。

9月19日上午11点15分左右，我和我的合伙人约翰·戈尔德斯坦
(Johann Goldstein) 先生一起进入中央路24号315室福利公司
(Welfare Co.) 的办公室推销手提包。在展示我们的商品时，
乔丹·施 (Jordan Sze) 先生表现出兴趣，并为他的妻子和妹妹
订购了两个手提包。随后他回到写字台前坐下。我们继续与上述
公司的经理交谈。上午11点45分左右，我注意到一名身穿西服的
中国男子进入办公室并走向柜台。他站在我左侧约两英尺远的地方。
我听到他低声说了几句我不懂的话，并注意到他在环顾房间。当他
看到施先生时，他从口袋里抽出右手，向施先生开了三枪。做完
这些后，袭击者立即转身离开了办公室。我跑到走廊里，大喊“警察”，
但发现附近没有人。于是我又回到办公室，从其中一扇窗户向楼下
的街道大喊“警察”。

签名：莫蒂希·茨威格。

pages.en:
Johann Goldstein,
Austrian, 810/77 East Seward Road.
Central Stn. 19-9-40.

I corroborated the statement made by my partner Mr.
Motih Zweig, in that I have been standing next to him, when
the shooting occurred in the office of the Welfare Co. Room 305
24 Central Road at about 11.45a.m. on Sept. 19th, 1940.

Johann Goldstein.
pages.zh:
约翰·戈尔德斯坦 (Johann Goldstein)，
奥地利人，东熙华德路810/77号。
中央捕房 1940年9月19日。

我证实我的合伙人莫蒂希·茨威格 (Motih Zweig) 先生所作的陈述，
因为当1940年9月19日上午11点45分左右，中央路24号305室福利公司
办公室发生枪击事件时，我就站在他旁边。

约翰·戈尔德斯坦。

pages.en:
Boku Shing
D.S. Suga
Korea
Central Stn. 19/9/40. D.S. Suga.

My name is Boku Shing(朴震), dry-goods broker with offices
at room 305, no.24 Central road, residing at No.64 Route Pichon,
F.C.

This room No.305 has been tenanted jointly by a German hand-
bag dealer, a Chinese friend of mine named Sze Ju Tong(史久章)
who is a lawyer, and myself for $128.00 per mensum. We have a
telephone installed jointly too.

At about 11.45a.m. 19/9/40 I was negotiating with the above
German hand-bag over handbag-business when a male Chinese came
in and I hear his ask who the layer Sze was. I also hear Sze
replied it was he, when 3 shots were fired. When I raised my
eyes I witnessed a male Chinese age about 23/4, dressed in
foreign style clothing going out of the room, while Sze was seated
on a chair nearby with his face bleeding profusely.

I realized Sze fell victim to the shooting, so I dashed out
of the office to arrest of assailant, but I could not find him.

In the meantime an ambulance of the S.F.B. arrived and took
Sze to the Lester Chinese Hospital.

I had not a good look at of the pistol.

I have been acquainted with Sze for the past 10 years.

We became acquainted when I was dealing in building materials
and he was in the employ of British owned Duncan & Company.

Towards the middle of July 1940 he opened the law office at
the present address and at the same time I removed there from the
French Concession and we have occupied this room to date.

As to Sze I knew little excepting he is a lawyer by occupation,
but I understand that he has recently been connected with a certain
pages.zh:
朴震 (Boku Shing)
D.S. 须贺 (Suga)
朝鲜
中央捕房 1940年9月19日。D.S. 须贺。

我叫朴震 (Boku Shing)，是百货经纪人，办公室位于中央路24号305室，
住法租界毕勋路64号。

这间305室由一名德国手提包商人、我的朋友兼律师施久章 (Sze Ju Tong)
以及我共同租用，每月租金128.00美元。我们也共同安装了一部电话。

1940年9月19日上午11点45分左右，我正在与上述德国手提包商洽谈
手提包生意，这时一名中国男子进来，我听见他问哪位是施律师。我还
听见施回答说他就是，此时响起了三声枪响。当我抬起眼睛时，目睹一名
年龄约23或24岁的中国男子，身穿西服走出房间，而施则坐在附近的椅子
上，面部大量出血。

我意识到施成了枪击的受害者，于是我冲出办公室试图逮捕袭击者，但未能
找到他。

与此同时，上海公共租界工部局火政处 (S.F.B.) 的一辆救护车赶到，将施
送往莱斯德华人医院 (Lester Chinese Hospital)。

我没有看清那把手枪。

我与施相识已有10年。

我们相识时，我经营建筑材料，而他受雇于英商邓肯公司 (Duncan & Company)。

1940年7月中旬左右，他在现址开设了律师事务所，同时我从法租界搬至此处，
至今我们一直占用这间办公室。

关于施，除了知道他是律师外，我知之甚少，但我了解到他最近与某家

pages.en:
Seamen's Association with offices at No.7E Jessfield Road.
The above is true statement.

Signed.
pages.zh:
海员协会有关联，该协会办公室位于杰斯菲尔德路7E号。
以上陈述属实。

签名。

pages.en:
Wong Wei,
Shanghai
Central Stn. 19-9-40

Wong Wei,31,Shanghai,M/residing at No. 9 Tsung Hwei Lee,
Elgin Road. I am employed as a clerk in the Kang Sang Weekly
Review. I made the acquaintance of Sze Ju Tong at No. 3
Jessfield Road where Mr. Tan Kwei Ying entertained his friends
about two months ago. At 7.30p.m. yesterday (18-9-40) I met
Sze at the Shing Yah Lou Restaurant, North Szechuen Road where
Mr. Lee Sze Zee gave an invitation. Mr. Lee insisted that I
would accompany him to call Mr. Sze's office on the 2nd floor,
24 Central Road at about noon today from where we would proceed
to his home at No. 43 Oong Ka Loung,Nantao, to partake of tiffin
At about 11.30a.m. (Summer hour) I went to No. 24 Central Road
where I met Sze and one of his friend believed to be a Japanese
whom I met on yesterday's invitation. We three then went
upstairs and awaited for another friend named Sung Ho Liang
intending to proceed to Nantao altogether. About 20 minutes
later, Mr. Sze was talking about the delay of Mr. Sung, there
appeared a youth, age about 23/24, thin face, 5' 3/4" high,
wearing light gray foreign clothes, and inquired who was Mr.
Sze Ju Tong. Sz Ju Tong replied "what is the matter, I am
Sze Ju Tong". However, the young man immediately produced a
pistol and fired 3 shots in succession aiming at the head of
Sze while I concealed myself on the sofa. When I stood up,
the assailant had already absconded. If Sze's nose was profusely
bleeding, I then sent a telephone message for an ambulance and
asked others to put an handkerchief on Sze's nose. On arrival o
the police, I asked them to send another telephone. At the same
time the ambulance arrived the scene I instructed an employee to
pages.zh:
黄伟 (Wong Wei)，
上海
中央捕房 1940年9月19日

黄伟，31岁，上海人，住爱文义路宗惠里9号。我在《康桑周刊》
(Kang Sang Weekly Review) 任职员。大约两个月前，在谭桂英
(Tan Kwei Ying) 先生在杰斯菲尔德路3号宴请朋友时，我结识了
施久章 (Sze Ju Tong)。昨晚（1940年9月18日）晚上7点30分，我在
北四川路新雅楼餐厅 (Shing Yah Lou Restaurant) 遇见了施先生，
当时李士济 (Lee Sze Zee) 先生发出邀请。李先生坚持要我陪同他
在今天中午左右去中央路24号二楼拜访施先生的办公室，然后我们将
前往南市翁家弄43号他家吃午饭。上午11点30分左右（夏令时），我
前往中央路24号，在那里遇到了施先生和他的一位朋友，据信是一位
日本人，我在昨天的聚会上见过他。我们三人随后上楼，等待另一位
名叫宋浩良 (Sung Ho Liang) 的朋友，打算一同前往南市。大约20分钟
后，施先生正谈论宋先生的迟到，这时出现了一名青年，年龄约23或
24岁，瘦脸，身高5英尺3/4英寸，身穿浅灰色西服，询问谁是施久章
先生。施久章回答说：“什么事，我就是施久章。”然而，这名青年立即
掏出手枪，瞄准施的头部连续开了三枪，而我则躲在沙发上。当我站起
来时，袭击者已经逃之夭夭。见施的鼻子大量出血，我便打电话叫救护
车，并请其他人用手帕按住施的鼻子。警察到达后，我请他们再打一个
电话。救护车到达现场的同时，我指示一名员工

pages.en:
-2-
escort Sze to the hospital and another employee to accompany
Police to the station. After that, I escorted Sze to go
downstairs by lift. At the main entrance a man who encountered
Sze asked me whether he could accompany Sze to the hospital, to
which I said it was quite possible. When the ambulance left the
scene I was summoned to give testimony at the station as above.
The above is my true statement.
Signed.
pages.zh:
-2-
护送施去医院，另一名员工陪同警察去捕房。之后，我陪施乘电梯下楼。
在大门口，一名遇到施的人问我是否可以陪同施去医院，我说完全可以。
救护车离开现场后，我被传唤到捕房如上所述作证。
以上是我的真实陈述。
签名。

pages.en:
Lieu Tsing Yuen

Tientsin
Central Stn.          19/9/40.

Lieu Tsing Yuen, age 31, native of Tientsin, W/fruit merchant,
residing 38 Sih Hwa Faung off Rue Stanislas Chevalier, F.C.
    At about 9a.m. on 19/9/40, I proceeded to room 306, 3rd
floor, No.24 Central Road, (the office of lawyer Sze Jen Dong)
with the intention of making arrangements about a pass for
Tootung with Zaung Mao Liang of the Tung Yih Transportation
Company. Whilst waiting in the office, I saw the lawyer Sze Jen
Dong, the accountant of the Tung Yih Transportation Company, Mr
Loh, Mr Wong and Mr Ling Tsung, both are friends of Lawyer Sze
Jen Dong. At that time there was also one coolie named Deng,
and three Jews in the office. I was still waiting for Zaung
when at 11.45a.m. an unknown person dressed in foreign style
clothing came into the office and asked which one was the lawyer
Sze. At that time, the lawyer Sze, who was sitting down, asked
this person what was the matter. The man in question produced
a pistol and fired 3 shots at him (lawyer Sze). After shooting,
the man immediately ran out of the office.
    Description of the man:
    Age about 26-7, height about 5'8", slim build, fair
complexion, long hair brushed back, wearing black foreign jacket
and grey pants, speaking with a Northern accent.

                        Signed. Lieu Tsing Yuen.
pages.zh:
刘清元 (Lieu Tsing Yuen)

天津
中央捕房          1940年9月19日。

刘清元，31岁，天津人，水果商，住法租界司各脱路 (Rue Stanislas Chevalier)
侧四华坊38号。
    1940年9月19日上午9点左右，我前往中央路24号三楼306室（施 Jen Dong
律师的办公室），打算与通益运输公司 (Tung Yih Transportation Company)
的张茂良 (Zaung Mao Liang) 安排去通东 (Tootung) 的通行证事宜。在办公
室等候时，我见到了施 Jen Dong 律师、通益运输公司的会计罗 (Loh) 先生、
黄 (Wong) 先生和林宗 (Ling Tsung) 先生，后两人都是施 Jen Dong 律师的朋
友。当时办公室里还有一名名叫邓的苦力，以及三名犹太人。我正在等待张
先生，上午11点45分，一名身穿西服的陌生人进入办公室，询问哪一位是施
律师。当时坐着的施律师问此人有什么事。该男子掏出手枪，向他（施律师）
开了三枪。开枪后，该男子立即跑出办公室。
    对该男子的描述：
    年龄约26-27岁，身高约5英尺8英寸，身材瘦削，肤色白皙，长发向后梳，
身穿黑色西式上衣和灰色裤子，说话带有北方口音。

                        签名。刘清元。

pages.en:
Loh Sih Fung
Seongkiang
Central Stn. 19/9/40.

Loh Sih Fung, 28, Seongkiang, W/clerk of the Tung Yih Company,
residing at no.19C, Lane 608, Yu Yuen Road.
Our company was removed into Room No.305 on the 25/8/40.
At 10a.m. on the 19/9/40, I attended my office to carry out my
duty. At about 11.45a.m. even date when I was sitting at my
desk, I saw an assailant coming in and firing three shots which
resulted in wounding Lawyer Sze. Noticing that Lawyer Sze was
lying in a pool of blood, I together with one named Tong Chung
Ching helped Lawyer Sze to sit in a chair. Lawyer Sze was subse-
quently conveyed to hospital.
The description of the assailant: age about 26/7, midium build,
wearing blue foreign style suit, appearance and dialect unavail-
able.

Signed.
pages.zh:
罗世丰 (Loh Sih Fung)
松江
中央捕房 1940年9月19日。

罗世丰，28岁，松江人，通益公司职员，住愚园路608弄19C号。
我公司于1940年8月25日迁入305室。
1940年9月19日上午10点，我到办公室履行职责。同日约上午11点45分，
当我坐在办公桌前时，我看见一名袭击者进来开了三枪，导致施律师受伤。
见施律师躺在血泊中，我与一名名叫童仲庆 (Tong Chung Ching) 的人一起
扶施律师坐在椅子上。施律师随后被送往医院。
对袭击者的描述：年龄约26或27岁，中等身材，身穿蓝色西服，外貌和
方言不详。

签名。

pages.en:
Dong Tsing Foo,
Shanghai
Central Stn. 19-9-40

Dong Tsing Foo, 16,Shanghai,S/residing 521/1252 Hue
Vallon,F.C.

I have been employed as an apprentice at the Sze Ju Tong
Lawyer Office, Room 305, 24 Central Road for the past 3 months.
At about 11.50a.m. 20-9-40, whilst sitting in the office, I
observed a man come and ask who is Mr. Sze ? Mr. Sze replied
"I am, what is the matter?". The stranger immediately produced
a pistol and fired 3 shots in succession against Sze. Sze
receiving bullet wounds collapsed on the floor, but the
assailant made good his escape. Someone in the office then
telephoned to the station for an ambulance and the injured man
was subsequently conveyed to the hospital.

The description of the assailant is as follows:-
Age about 26/27,height 5'8",round face,fresh complexion,
long hair brushed back,wearing navy blue foreign dress,
dialect unknown.

Signed.
pages.zh:
董清福 (Dong Tsing Foo)，
上海
中央捕房 1940年9月19日

董清福，16岁，上海人，住法租界华伦路521/1252号。

过去3个月我一直在中央路24号305室施久章律师事务所担任学徒。
1940年9月20日上午11点50分左右，当我坐在办公室里时，观察到一名
男子进来问谁是施先生？施先生回答说：“我是，有什么事？”陌生人立即
掏出手枪，向施连续开了三枪。施中弹后倒在地上，但袭击者成功逃脱。
办公室里的某人随后打电话给捕房叫救护车，伤者随后被送往医院。

对袭击者的描述如下：
年龄约26或27岁，身高5英尺8英寸，圆脸，面色红润，长发向后梳，
身穿深蓝色西服，方言不明。

签名。

pages.en:
C.P.C. 868 Wong Ching Pau

Central Stn.          19/9/40.

    I was on traffic duty at the corner of Kiukiang and Szechuen
roads. At about 11.55a.m. 19/9/40, I went off duty and on
passing Kiukiang Road near Central Road I heard shooting. I
did not know where it was taking place. I was later informed
by a foreigner (name unknown) that the shooting was taking place
in room 303, 3rd floor of No.24 Central Road. I immediately
proceeded into the building where I found a male Chinese had
been shot. I reported the occurrence to the Police by telephone
whilst the injured man was removed to the hospital by an
ambulance. I brought Lim Tsing Yuen of that particular office
to the station.
R/

                                Signed.
pages.zh:
巡警 868号 黄景保 (Wong Ching Pau)

中央捕房          1940年9月19日。

    我当时在九江路和四川路路口执行交通勤务。1940年9月19日上午11点
55分左右，我下班经过靠近中央路的九江路时，听到了枪声。我不知道枪声
来自何处。后来一名外国人（姓名不详）告诉我，枪击发生在中央路24号三
楼303室。我立即进入大楼，发现一名中国男子中枪。在伤者被救护车送往
医院的同时，我用电话向警方报告了此事。我将该办公室的刘清元 (Lim Tsing
Yuen) 带到捕房。
R/

                                签名。
